jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Functieomschrijving

Ben jij een .NET Developer en wil je werken aan complexe softwareoplossingen met de flexibiliteit om minimaal 2 dagen per week thuis te werken? Werk je graag met C#, ASP.NET en cloudplatformen zoals Azure? Dan zoekt VX Company jou!

Over VX Company

Bij VX Company werk je in een team van ervaren software developers, engineers en architecten. We zijn gespecialiseerd in IT consultancy en bouwen state-of-the-art softwareoplossingen voor klanten in Nederland.
Waarom kiezen voor VX Company
Werken met moderne technologie zoals .NET, Azure en cloud-native oplossingen
Projecten bij verschillende klanten (consultancy)
Veel ruimte voor groei en ontwikkeling als developer
Sterke focus op kennisdeling en innovatie

Wat ga je doen als .NET Developer

Als Software Developer .NET werk je aan moderne, schaalbare en veilige applicaties. Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, realiseert integraties tussen systemen en denkt mee over architectuur en performance.
Je werkt aan diverse projecten bij verschillende opdrachtgevers, variërend van overheidsorganisaties zoals het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Belastingdienst tot commerciële organisaties zoals Action, Royal HaskoningDHV en ENGIE. De ene keer bouw je een API-koppeling, de andere keer werk je aan een nieuw platform of backend systeem. Samen kijken we welke opdrachten passen bij jouw ervaring en ambities.

Tech stack en werkwijze

Je werkt met technologieën zoals .NET (Core), C#, ASP.NET en cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of Google Cloud. Daarnaast werk je met tools en technieken zoals Docker, Kubernetes en CI/CD pipelines. Je werkt in Agile teams.

Groei en ontwikkeling

Bij VX Company krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen als .NET Developer en Software Engineer. Je werkt samen met ervaren developers, deelt kennis en krijgt de vrijheid om je technische skills verder te verdiepen.

Vereisten

Wie ben jij?
Je bent een backend developer of .NET developer die graag werkt aan technische uitdagingen. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, denkt mee over oplossingen en voelt je thuis in een Agile werkomgeving.

Verder heb je
Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding (bij voorkeur IT)
Ervaring met .NET, C# en ASP.NET
Ervaring met of interesse in cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP)
Ervaring met Agile
Kennis van Docker of Kubernetes
Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Wat je van ons krijgt
Salaris tot €7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring
8,33% vakantiegeld en 4% eindejaarsuitkering
Flexibele mobiliteitsregeling (leaseauto of vergoeding)
29 vakantiedagen met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding
Hybride werken (minimaal 2 dagen thuiswerken) en een ingerichte thuiswerkplek
Studiekostenregeling en persoonlijk ontwikkelprogramma

Een actieve personeelsvereniging met leuke events en gezamenlijke lunches, van sushiworkshops tot een dagje Efteling
Pensioen via Nationale-Nederlanden, met werkgeversbijdrage en keuze in eigen inleg

De software ondersteunt diverse zorgdisciplines en is ontworpen om zorgprofessionals te ontlasten van administratieve werkzaamheden, zodat zij zich volledig kunnen richten op hun cliënten.
Innovatie staat centraal. Door de inzet van AI-functionaliteiten wordt dossiervorming slimmer en worden werkprocessen efficiënter ingericht. Als developer werk je aan technologie die directe en tastbare impact heeft op de kwaliteit van zorg.

De organisatiecultuur is informeel én professioneel: korte lijnen, open communicatie en een gezamenlijke focus op kwaliteit. Het bedrijf telt circa 19 medewerkers en je komt terecht in een hecht developmentteam van vijf collega’s. Er is volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief, meedenken over architectuur en het continu verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen.

Functie-informatie:

Als senior .NET developer werk je aan robuuste en betrouwbare softwareoplossingen binnen het zorgdomein. Je ontwikkelt applicaties die dagelijks een cruciale rol spelen voor zorgprofessionals en patiënten. Betrouwbaarheid, security en performance zijn hierbij essentieel: jouw technische keuzes hebben directe invloed op de continuïteit en kwaliteit van zorg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein, ervaren development team waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en eigenaarschap vanzelfsprekend zijn. Je bent van begin tot eind betrokken bij het ontwikkelproces en levert een actieve bijdrage aan architectuurvraagstukken, optimalisaties en de verdere doorontwikkeling van het platform.

Signaleren, volgen en toepassen van nieuwe technologieën en best practices

Analytisch en gestructureerd in je werkwijze
Sociale teamplayer met een sterk gevoel voor samenwerking

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Voor een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is en werkt aan maatschappelijk relevante digitale oplossingen, zijn wij op zoek naar een Software Architect. Je komt terecht in een professionele IT-omgeving waar softwareontwikkeling, cloudtechnologie en architectuur samenkomen.

Als Software Architect speel je een belangrijke rol bij het vertalen van strategische architectuurprincipes naar concrete technische oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met Enterprise Architects, developers en verschillende stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande oplossingen aansluiten bij de technische en organisatorische doelstellingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en verder ontwikkelen van toekomstbestendige softwareoplossingen. Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Vertalen van de doelarchitectuur naar concrete oplossingen die door developmentteams gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
Ontwerpen van oplossingsrichtingen in samenwerking met Enterprise Architects en ontwikkelteams.
Ontwerpen van softwarearchitecturen voor nieuwe producten en digitale diensten.
Opstellen van transitieplannen voor het moderniseren van bestaande oplossingen en applicaties.
Definiëren van non-functional requirements, zoals security, performance, schaalbaarheid en beschikbaarheid.
Onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en beoordelen hoe deze binnen de organisatie kunnen worden toegepast.
Meewerken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern softwarelandschap, bestaande uit zowel on-premise technologie als cloud- en SaaS-oplossingen.
Werken met Microsoft-technologie en Azure binnen een breed en voortdurend veranderend IT-landschap.
Fungeren als technisch sparringpartner voor developers en andere IT-professionals.
Coachen van ontwikkelaars en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van softwarearchitectuur binnen de organisatie.

Je krijgt hierbij veel ruimte om inhoudelijk mee te denken en invloed uit te oefenen op de technische richting van de organisatie.

Wat bieden wij?

Je komt terecht in een professionele en collegiale werkomgeving waarin kennisdeling, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief worden gestimuleerd. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:
Een salaris tot circa €5.800 bruto per maand o.b.v. 36-urige werkweek, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
Een aantrekkelijk individueel keuzebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, opleiding of extra inkomen.
Een eindejaarsuitkering.
Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken.
Volledige vergoeding van openbaar vervoer en een aantrekkelijke kilometervergoeding.
Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en professionele ontwikkeling.
Een laptop en smartphone of een passende telefoonvergoeding.
Een veelzijdige functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van het IT-landschap.

Wat breng je mee?

Voor deze functie zoeken we een ervaren Software Architect die zowel technisch sterk is als gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders.
Je beschikt over:
Een hbo-diploma in de richting van Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
Ruime ervaring binnen een Microsoft-georiënteerde IT-omgeving.
Ervaring als Software Architect en bij voorkeur ook een achtergrond als software developer.
Uitgebreide kennis van Microsoft Azure, Visual Studio en Azure DevOps.
Ervaring met Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) en het ontwerpen van complexe softwareoplossingen.
Ervaring met het opstellen van architectuurprincipes, technische ontwerpen en transitieplannen.
Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.
Het vermogen om als senior gesprekspartner complexe technische vraagstukken begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende stakeholders.
Sterke communicatieve en analytische vaardigheden.
Organisatiesensitiviteit en het vermogen om effectief om te gaan met verschillende belangen en veranderende omstandigheden.

Interesse?

Ben jij een ervaren Software Architect en wil je werken aan complexe vraagstukken binnen een organisatie waar technologie een belangrijke maatschappelijke rol speelt? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure
jobs.description:
Bij Solvinity werk je aan Azure-omgevingen voor organisaties die geen fouten kunnen veroorloven. Denk aan het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en toonaangevende financiële dienstverleners. Maar deze rol gaat verder dan engineering alleen. Je werkt ook mee in het Cloud Center of Excellence van het ministerie, waar je de cloud-strategie van een van de grootste overheidsorganisaties van Nederland mede vormgeeft. Diepgaand technisch werk, gecombineerd met echte strategische impact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert veilige Azure-omgevingen voor klanten met strenge eisen op het gebied van beveiliging en compliance. Je werkt met Terraform, Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en Azure Policies. Deployments automatiseer je via CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitLab. Wijzigingen rollen geautomatiseerd en foutloos uit. Je beheert het versie- en lifecycle management van cloud resources en zorgt dat alles gedocumenteerd en herleidbaar is.
Je stelt accreditatiedocumentatie op, voert risicoanalyses en security assessments uit en zorgt dat cloudservices aantoonbaar voldoen aan normen zoals BIO2 en NIS2. Je bent daarin een betrouwbare gesprekspartner voor security- en risk-stakeholders.

Jouw kerntaken

· Ontwerpen en beheren van Azure-netwerkarchitecturen (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
· Configureren van Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en implementeren van zero-trust netwerksegmentatie
· Bouwen en onderhouden van Infrastructure as Code met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines
· Opstellen en implementeren van Azure Policies en policy-initiatieven voor governance en compliance
· Opstellen van accreditatiedocumentatie, risicoanalyses en security assessments
Je werkt in een klein, hecht cloudteam met korte lijnen. Er zijn twee à drie standups per week. Geen zware vergadercultuur, wel nauwe samenwerking met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders.

Wat bieden wij?

· €5.356 – €7.961 bruto per maand (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
· Mobiliteitsvergoeding of een lease-auto
· 32 tot 40-urige werkweek
· Grotendeels thuiswerken met een vaste dag per week op kantoor en bij de klant
· 80% pensioenbijdrage van de werkgever
26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding
· Tot €300 per jaar voor jouw sportactiviteiten
Solvinity investeert structureel in jouw ontwikkeling. Vanaf dag één volg je relevante opleidingen en trainingen. Na twee jaar in dienst ontvang je €1.000 extra opleidingsbudget dat je volledig zelf mag invullen. Denk aan een Azure-certificering zoals de AZ-104 of AZ-400, de Palo Alto PCNSE of een ander traject dat bij jou past. Jaarlijks stel je samen met je manager een persoonlijk opleidingsplan op.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren cloud engineer met een analytische instelling en een security-first mindset. Je bouwt niet alleen — je denkt ook na over waarom je iets zo inricht en wat de risico’s zijn. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders. Je bent nauwkeurig, documentatievaardig en weet complexe technische vraagstukken helder op te schrijven.
Wat je meebrengt:

· Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare cloud-rol
· Diepgaande kennis van Azure-netwerken (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
· Hands-on ervaring met Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en zero-trust segmentatie
· Aantoonbare ervaring met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
· Ervaring met Azure Policies, accreditatieprocessen en compliance-kaders (BIO2, NIS2 is een pré)
Kennis van Bicep of ARM is een pré. Een relevante Azure-certificering (AZ-104, AZ-400) of Palo Alto PCNSE is een pluspunt, maar aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt minstens zo zwaar. Je beheerst het Nederlands goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, op minimaal hbo-niveau.

Over Solvinity

Solvinity levert Secure Managed Cloud Services aan organisaties met hoge beveiligingseisen. Hiermee ondersteunt het bedrijf de (rijks-)overheid, gemeenten en toonaangevende organisaties in de financiële en zakelijke dienstverlening, zoals het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, Politie Nederland, TransLink (OV-chipkaart), ING en Klaverblad. Solvinity ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de complexe platformen waarop bedrijfskritische applicaties veilig en optimaal functioneren. Daarnaast levert het bedrijf CI/CD, containertechnologie en ‘Stretched’ DevSecOps oplossingen voor softwareontwikkelaars.
Solvinity onderscheidt zich op het gebied van cybersecurity met een uitgebreid portfolio aan securitydiensten en -oplossingen en biedt, met een meerderheidsbelang in Securify.nl , aanvullende cybersecurity diensten. Daarnaast heeft het bedrijf certificeringen volgens (inter)nationale normen als ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS en heeft het als eerste MSP in Nederland SOC 1 en 2 compliance rapporten voor de gehele beheeromgeving van de private én Azure cloud.
Kijk voor meer informatie op [ www.solvinity.nl ]( http://www.solvinity.nl ), of volg Solvinity op LinkedIn.

Interesse?

Passen we bij elkaar? Wil je ons daarvan overtuigen? Bel of app dan onze recruitmentspecialist, Niels Moelard, op 06-30399509 of stuur een mail naar niels.moelard@solvinity.com We streven naar een snel en persoonlijk sollicitatieproces: na een eerste (online) kennismaking volgt een gesprek op kantoor in Amersfoort. jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Netherlands.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Product (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round
(around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.

Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.

At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer
who thinks like a product builder, thrives in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and is passionate about creating robust, scalable financial infrastructure. You'll be part of a domain team where various engineering crafts (Backend, Frontend, Mobile, ML/AI engineers, and QA) work together to own and evolve a shared product area that delivers real value to hundreds of thousands of businesses across Europe.

About You and What You'll Do:

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. You communicate clearly across disciplines and genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team where everyone contributes to solving the same customer problems. Above all, you're curious – about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

As a product-minded backend engineer, you don't just implement tickets. You understand the "why" behind what you're building, challenge assumptions when needed, and proactively identify opportunities to create better outcomes. You're comfortable discussing trade-offs with product managers, explaining technical constraints to business stakeholders, and collaborating with frontend and mobile engineers to design elegant end-to-end solutions.

You have deep expertise in .NET and C# with a strong appreciation for maintainable, scalable code, and distributed architectures. But more importantly, you know when to apply that expertise and when simpler solutions serve the product better. You've built data-intensive applications before and understand the concepts of working in a regulated environment.

You take ownership not just of your code, but of the outcomes. You move without being prompted, whether that's jumping into a customer issue, improving team processes, or mentoring colleagues. You're curious about adjacent domains – you might peek at the frontend code, ask questions about the ML models, or dive into analytics to understand how features perform.

Quality is non-negotiable for you. Automated testing, thorough code reviews, and security best practices are fundamental to how you work. You balance technical excellence with pragmatism, always keeping the end user and business goals in mind.

Your experience includes:

At least 5 years of professional backend development with a product engineering mindset
Excellent knowledge of .NET platform and C#
Hands-on experience architecting and evolving distributed systems in production
Proven ability to collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and engineers from other disciplines
Strong business acumen – you understand how your work connects to company objectives
Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences
A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code

Our tech stack

Backend: .NET/C#, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes, GCP.
You'll work alongside teams using React (Web), Swift (iOS) / Kotlin (Android), Python/ML frameworks, and modern test automation tools (Playwright, Appium).

Recruitment flow:

Recruiter Interview
First Technical Interview
System Design Interview
Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
Offer

What You Will Get In Return

Make a genuine impact on the product

Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.

Work in the EU

Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Become a stock options holder

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Receive unwavering support and care

Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.

Work & Swim program

Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Novatus is a Series B scale-up RegTech SaaS provider and boutique advisory practice, enabling financial services firms to solve complex challenges and redefine what’s possible through expert-led technology and consulting. Across both our technology and consulting services, Novatus delivers practical solutions to some of the most complex regulatory, data and operational challenges in financial services.

Our SaaS platform, En>ACT (short for ensuring more accurate, complete and timely reporting) , is a market-leading solution for regulatory transaction reporting and reconciliation, providing real-time, independent oversight of transaction reporting across all global regulatory regimes. En>ACT is the only real-time assurance solution that tests 100% of transactions and 100% of fields, replacing sample-based reviews and static PDF reports delivered months after the event with live, actionable insights. This helps firms remediate quickly, reduce risk, and meet regulatory obligations with confidence. Already trusted by more than 45 firms worldwide, the platform is scalable, proven, and designed for both business and technical users.

Alongside our SaaS offering, our unique model delivers consulting services to solve complex challenges, combining deep expertise, ownership and delivery to create lasting change. Our expertise spans Strategy & Operations, Data & AI, Risk & Resilience, Compliance, Transaction Reporting, and ESG. We embed ourselves within client teams to deliver both insight and execution, taking ownership of outcomes and driving measurable impact.

Since our launch in 2019, we have scaled rapidly, creating space for our people to grow the business. Backed by North American private equity investment, and partnerships with the London Stock Exchange Group and Snowflake’s global data platform, we are shaping the future of financial services through innovation in both consulting and technology. Now a team of 120 globally, our growth plans do not stop here: we are looking for top-tier talent to join us on our journey and enable our next phase of success.

Job Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer
, you'll build and maintain our core domain services. You'll write clean, well-tested code, deliver reliably, and hold a consistently high standard in everything you ship.

You'll work within a modern architecture built on Domain-Driven Design, event-driven patterns, and hexagonal architecture. You'll join at a pivotal stage as we re-platform from a legacy Django application to a service-based .NET platform on AWS. Our systems power regulatory reporting for major financial institutions, requiring precision, traceability, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

Build and maintain core domain services using C# and .NET.
Deliver high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code.
Review peers' code and contribute to a strong, consistent engineering standard.
Build systems that are auditable, resilient, and observable in regulated environments.
Use AI tooling in your workflow to deliver efficiently without compromising quality.
Collaborate with Product, Data Engineering, DevOps, QA, and Regulatory teams to turn requirements into working software.

About You

Required
Experience

Strong hands-on experience building services with C# and .NET.
Solid experience working in event-driven (we use Kafka), service-based systems.
Familiar with Domain-Driven Design and hexagonal architecture.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (clean code, automated testing, CI/CD, observability).
Hands-on experience with AWS.
Actively use AI tooling (e.g. Copilot, Claude Code, Codex etc) and have opinions on best practices.
Ability to translate regulatory or domain requirements into working code.
High ownership mindset and accountability for delivery and reliability.

Beneficial but not essential experience

Experience re-platforming or modernizing legacy systems.
FinTech, RegTech, or financial services background.

Why Join Us?

Work Across Disciplines:
You won't be confined to a single track- you will develop a broader skillset across our capabilities and offerings.

Solve Problems that Matter:
Work on complex challenges, where your thinking, analysis, and execution have real impact.

Flat, Visible, Collaborative:
We keep the structure flat, so you can collaborate directly with senior leaders and experienced specialists. Your work is visible, your perspectives are valued, and you will see the impact of your contributions every day.

A Place for Builders:
This is a great place for people who enjoy driving results and taking ownership. If you are driven to add value and help grow our business, you will enjoy a rewarding experience that recognises your contributions.

Perks & Benefits:

Private Medical Insurance (via AXA): includes mental health, dental, vision, and private GP access
Life Insurance - 4× salary (via Unum)
Unum’s Help@Hand: includes GP access, medical second opinions, physiotherapy, lifestyle coaching, savings and discounts, mental health support, bereavement counselling, and cancer support services for you, your partner, and your child(ren)

Accelerated career progression based on readiness and performance, not tenure or time spent in role
Holiday entitlement increases with tenure
Flexible hours with core collaboration time
Paid volunteering leave
Gym & fitness discounts
Bi-annual socials
Office snacks and drinks
Interest-based working groups to collaborate and innovate

Join Protein Works as our Senior Backend Developer, and build a greenfield, cloud-native platform from the ground up using Go and modern microservices architecture.

About The Role

The Protein Works is a UK direct-to-consumer sports nutrition brand. We develop and manufacture our own products, sell them through our own e-commerce platform and ship them from our own warehouse. Behind the website sits a set of internal applications connecting orders, stock, finance, fulfilment and manufacturing, alongside a growing number of marketplaces and third-party services.

We are replacing those legacy internal applications with a new cloud-native platform: independently deployable services that will become the single integration layer between the website, finance, warehouse and manufacturing, and a foundation for AI-assisted automation across the business. This role is a core builder of that platform.

You will join a small, polyglot engineering team working DevOps, Information Security, Data and IT. Go is our preferred language for services because of its performance and operational simplicity, but we hire for engineering depth first: if your background is C#, Java or PHP and you are willing to work in Go, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Platform Development & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain microservices and domain models (orders, stock, fulfilment, finance) using Go, Domain-Driven Design, enterprise integration patterns, and clean architecture to incrementally replace legacy applications.

Integration & Asynchronous Workflows: Build event-driven and queue-based workflows with REST APIs, authentication, idempotency, and contract testing to connect e-commerce, ERP, WMS, finance, and manufacturing systems.

Operations, Security & AI: Own end-to-end delivery including containers, CI/CD, IaC, full observability (metrics, traces, logs), security/privacy compliance (OWASP, GDPR, pen testing), and day-to-day use of AI-assisted/agentic tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across tech and business teams, write ADRs, contribute to golden-path templates/standards, and translate business needs into technical execution.

What you will bring

Essential

Backend & Architecture: 5+ years of backend development (Go, Java, C#, or PHP with a focus/openness to Go) with strong CS/software engineering foundations, SOLID principles, and clean/event-driven patterns across microservices and monoliths.
Data & Async Systems: Solid background in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and asynchronous messaging (queues, events, retries, idempotency).
DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with Docker, Linux/Windows, Git/GitHub, Jira/Agile, monitoring/alerting, and diagnostic/profiling tools in high-volume e-commerce environments.
Communication & AI Integration: Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills, coupled with active practice using AI development/coding tools.

Desirable

AI & Cloud Technologies: Agentic AI (LLMs, frameworks, guardrails) and cloud platforms (AWS, IaC/Terraform, serverless, managed messaging, Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
Advanced Engineering & Integrations: Production Go experience, GoF/Enterprise integration patterns, durable workflows, contract testing, ERP/WMS/e-commerce integrations, OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Datadog, and OWASP/ISO 27001 security standards.

How we work

Two-week sprints for planned platform work and a Kanban lane for operational and integration requests, both in Jira. Pull requests with code review, automated tests and CI/CD to staging and production. Architecture Decision Records for anything that changes the shape of the platform, and golden-path templates per language so services stay consistent without forcing one runtime. Observability, security and documentation are part of the definition of done.

jobs.title: Backend Systems Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Candour Solutions Limited is a forward-thinking, technology-driven organization dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions that streamline business operations and enhance customer experiences. With a strong commitment to excellence and continuous investment in cutting-edge technologies, Candour Solutions has established itself as a leader in providing scalable and reliable software systems across various industries. The company's culture fosters collaboration, innovation, and professional growth, making it an ideal environment for talented professionals to thrive and contribute to impactful projects.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced Backend Systems Developer to join our dynamic engineering team at Candour Solutions Limited. In this role, you will be instrumental in developing and maintaining critical backend integrations that underpin our digital platform. Your work will ensure seamless data exchange between customer-facing applications and core operational systems such as warehouse management, ERP, and finance platforms. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on high-performance, scalable, and resilient systems that support millions of data points daily. As part of our team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, and operational teams, to deliver robust technical solutions that drive business success.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of four years of professional experience in backend software development, with a strong background in strongly typed programming languages. You should have proven expertise in integrating complex business-critical systems, particularly ERP, warehouse management, or finance platforms. Strong SQL skills, including database design and performance tuning, are essential. A solid understanding of software architecture principles such as SOLID, Clean Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design is required. Experience with modern development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and version control systems like Git, is also necessary. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications, message queues, and event-driven architectures will be highly advantageous. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include designing, developing, and maintaining backend integrations between digital platforms and core business systems such as warehouse, ERP, and finance solutions. You will build scalable middleware to support order processing, inventory synchronization, and real-time data exchange, ensuring high efficiency and reliability. Developing and maintaining REST APIs and event-driven integrations across multiple systems will be a core part of your role. You will implement queue-based processing to support high-volume asynchronous workloads while enhancing system resilience through retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and fault-tolerant design principles. Collaborating with engineering teams, product managers, and operational stakeholders, you will deliver high-quality technical solutions aligned with business needs. You will contribute to engineering standards, conduct code reviews, mentor junior team members, and share knowledge to foster continuous improvement. Developing modern, cloud-ready services with clean, maintainable, and scalable architecture will be essential. Monitoring system performance and identifying opportunities for enhancement in reliability, scalability, and efficiency will be ongoing aspects of your responsibilities.

Benefits

At Candour Solutions Limited, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your professional growth and personal well-being. You will receive a competitive salary within the range of £50,000 to £60,000, complemented by flexible hybrid working arrangements that promote work-life balance. Our benefits include opportunities for training and development, access to cutting-edge technologies, and participation in innovative projects. We foster a collaborative environment with a focus on diversity and inclusion, ensuring all team members feel valued and empowered. Additional perks may include health insurance options, pension schemes, and regular team-building activities. We are committed to providing a positive and stimulating workplace where your contributions make a meaningful impact.

Equal Opportunity

Candour Solutions Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our creativity, innovation, and overall success, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Systems Developer to join our dynamic Member Services team at Brightwell. This pivotal role involves the configuration, support, and ongoing development of the IntelliPen Pensions Administration platform. As a Senior Systems Developer, you will work closely with internal teams, third-party partners, and stakeholders to ensure the platform's continuous enhancement, stability, and alignment with business objectives. Your expertise will help drive system improvements, optimize functionality, and deliver a seamless experience for our members and operational staff. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in pensions administration systems, excellent problem-solving skills, and a passion for technological innovation.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will have substantial experience in supporting and developing defined benefit pensions administration systems. A strong technical background with advanced SQL skills is essential, along with familiarity with platforms such as IntelliPen or similar systems. Candidates should demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of delivering technology enhancements that improve operational efficiency and member outcomes. A solid understanding of system configuration, testing methodologies, and change management processes is required. Additionally, effective communication skills and the ability to lead and influence stakeholders at all levels are vital. Relevant qualifications in computer science, information technology, or related fields are preferred.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and enhance core IntelliPen platform functionalities, including workflows, reporting, document generation, member portals, calculations, and system integrations to meet evolving business needs.
Provide expert technical support to development teams and operational staff, resolving incident reports and complex system issues efficiently to minimize downtime.
Collaborate with internal change management, project teams, and external partners to deliver system improvements and new features, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.

Our offerings include a competitive salary, hybrid working arrangements, and opportunities for professional development. Employees can enjoy an annual performance bonus, 25 days of holiday (which increases to 30 days with service) plus bank holidays, and a pension scheme with employer contributions ranging from 15% to 17%, depending on age. We also provide 8 times salary life insurance, family-friendly policies such as extended maternity, adoption, and paternity leave, and access to health assessments and a health cash plan. Brightwell supports continuous learning through professional study assistance, and our Employee Assistance Programme and Wellhub wellness platform promote overall well-being and work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity

Brightwell is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all colleagues are valued and respected. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. We ensure fair treatment, equal access to opportunities, and the elimination of discrimination in all aspects of employment. Our commitment to equality is embedded in our corporate values and daily practices, creating an environment where everyone can thrive, contribute meaningfully, and reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Application Architect
jobs.description:
Fujitsu is looking for an experienced Application Architect
to support a high-impact project for one of our EU Institution client
.

Location: Warsaw

Languages: English B2

Work Model: Hybrid

Context/Project: Application design and architecting
, focusing on systems and applications integration on data and API levels

Education Requirement: Level 7 – Master’s degree

Security/Integrity: Personal Security Clearance Required
: RESTREINT UE/EU RESTRICTED
(procedure must be initiated within first 45 days of assignment)

Company Description

Fujitsu is a global leader in digital services, transforming organizations and the world through innovation. With a commitment to sustainability, Fujitsu builds trust in society by leveraging cutting-edge technology and innovation. Our services aim to drive positive change and create lasting impact in various industries globally.

DESCRIPTION OF THE TASKS

The selected candidate will perform the following typical tasks and responsibilities:
Architectural Design:
Designing and communicating enterprise-wide database architectures, schemas, analytic platforms, and BI services.
Standards Setting:
Setting standards in the scope of design, development, quality, and testing.
Requirements Translation:
Eliciting needs, analyzing requirements, and transferring business, user, and technical needs into formal architectures.
System Lifecycle Management:
Identifying options for potential solutions, maintaining and tracking architecture throughout the systems lifecycle.
Project Mapping:
Mapping business goals, project benefits, priorities, and system features.
Leadership:
Leading development teams and development processes.
Optimization:
Optimizing systems from the point of view of performance, security, and quality, and collecting/interpreting system metrics.
Integration Support:
Contributing to systems design, testing, quality assurance, and change management.
Infrastructure & Repository:
Estimating and sizing network infrastructure and contributing to the Enterprise Architecture repository.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Integration Expertise:
Expert in architecting systems integration on data and API levels, as well as designing integration platform connectors, flows, and service bus solutions.
Technical Knowledge:
Excellent knowledge of integration platforms (e.g., Tibco, Mulesoft
), SOA, databases, and cloud integration patterns.
Modelling Proficiency:
Sound knowledge of designing systems in UML
and proficiency in using modelling tools like Sparx Enterprise Architect
or Aris Architect.
Framework Familiarity:
Familiar with architectural frameworks such as TOGAF, Zachman
, or the Azure Well-Architected framework.
Modern Infrastructure:
Familiarity with serverless and containerisation platforms in cloud and on-premises environments, and the DevSecOps approach.
Soft Skills:
Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and effective documentation skills.

MANDATORY EXPERTISE

Experience with modelling in Archimate
Experience with European Interoperability Framework or other interinstitutional frameworks
Experience with applying architecture styles and patterns

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Poland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: AI-Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?

Join either Data Discovery & Experience
or API Platform
, two teams within API & Data Products Solutions.

Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Developer who is excited about building the next generation of AI-powered experiences.

About The Role

You will help shape AI-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

Working hands-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

As part of a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.

Help evolve our Data Discovery & Experience or API Platform capabilities.
Design and develop AI-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
Help ensure secure access using open standards.
Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
Contribute to AI literacy and AI-enabled ways of working.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the Data Discovery & Experience
team or the API Platform
team.

The Data Discovery & Experience
team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

The API Platform
team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.

Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

Who are you?

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.

You Also Have

Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data & Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
At least 1-2 years of practical, hands-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real-world applications.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, TypeScript, or Python.

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
Cloud-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Sweden.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Headless CMS Solutions Architect based in Sweden.

This is a senior, client-facing opportunity focused on designing modern, scalable digital content platforms using headless and composable CMS technologies.

You will lead discovery engagements, translate business and editorial needs into technical solutions, and guide clients through technology evaluation and architecture decisions.

The role combines content strategy, cloud architecture, systems integration, development considerations, security, and enterprise digital transformation.

You will work across platforms including Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, and Strapi, objectively assessing their capabilities against specific client requirements.

The position also requires a strong understanding of AWS environments and how CMS platforms integrate with cloud-based applications and infrastructure.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate architectural recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This role is well suited to an experienced architect or consultant who enjoys solving complex digital-content challenges and shaping practical implementation roadmaps.

Accountabilities

Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, and consulting engagements to understand business, editorial, technical, integration, security, and content requirements.
Gather, analyze, and document current-state requirements and translate them into scalable future-state digital platform architectures.
Evaluate headless CMS platforms and objectively recommend solutions based on client needs, technical constraints, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
Design scalable content models, schemas, reusable components, taxonomies, metadata structures, and composable content architectures.
Define editorial workflows, approval processes, role-based permissions, localization strategies, and publishing processes.
Design integrations between CMS platforms and enterprise applications, services, APIs, and other digital systems.
Develop architectures for multilingual content, accessibility, technical SEO, search, content governance, and modern web standards.
Design CMS migration strategies for legacy platforms such as Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore, and custom-built systems.
Assess how headless CMS solutions should integrate with AWS-based applications and infrastructure, including services such as S3, CloudFront, Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Cognito, IAM, Route 53, WAF, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, and EventBridge.
Collaborate closely with front-end, cloud, DevOps, security, UX, and development teams to ensure architectural decisions can be implemented effectively.
Produce architecture diagrams, technology recommendations, implementation roadmaps, technical documentation, and other solution-design materials.
Present architectural recommendations clearly to executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, and developers.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and potential scalability challenges throughout discovery and solution design.
Challenge requirements constructively when simpler, more scalable, or more maintainable approaches are appropriate.
Support implementation planning and ensure proposed solutions align with business objectives and technical realities.

Requirements

Significant professional experience working with headless CMS and composable digital-platform architectures.
Strong hands-on experience with at least two of Storyblok, Sanity, Contentful, or Strapi, with familiarity across the broader platform landscape preferred.
Practical experience with Storyblok features such as Visual Editor, components, workflows, localization, roles and permissions, Content Delivery API, and Management API.
Practical experience with Sanity, including Sanity Studio, structured content, schemas, GROQ, Content Lake, custom editorial experiences, and integrations.
Practical experience with Contentful, including content models, localization, environments, permissions, workflows, Content Delivery API, and Content Management API.
Practical experience with Strapi, including Content Type Builder, components, Dynamic Zones, REST and GraphQL APIs, permissions, plugins, and cloud or self-hosted deployments.
Experience leading CMS or digital-platform discovery and recommending enterprise content-management solutions.
Strong understanding of AWS and cloud-based architecture, with the ability to design solutions and collaborate effectively with cloud and DevOps specialists.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, API integrations, structured content, and composable architecture.
Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Nuxt.
Experience designing enterprise systems integrations and CMS migration strategies.
Strong understanding of content governance, multilingual and localized content, role-based permissions, editorial workflows, technical SEO, accessibility, and modern web standards.
Experience producing architecture diagrams, technical documentation, implementation roadmaps, and technology recommendations.
Strong consulting, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.
Comfortable working with executives, business stakeholders, content teams, IT departments, developers, and other technical specialists.
Ability to evaluate technologies objectively, identify risks and dependencies, and communicate architectural trade-offs clearly.
Experience with enterprise search, Digital Asset Management, CRM, LMS, marketing automation, analytics, or identity platforms is an asset.
Additional experience with AWS Solutions Architect certification, CMS certifications, Next.js/React, Node.js, Terraform or Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevOps, AWS OpenSearch, Digital Asset Management platforms, CRM, marketing automation, or Learning Management Systems is considered a plus.

jobs.description:

Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives enterprises a governed context graph for analytics and AI. Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.

About The Role

We are seeking a Managing Architect to join our Professional Services team, helping customers get to value faster while driving successful outcomes across the customer lifecycle. You will lead complex technical engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to customers, and partner closely with Sales and delivery partners from pre-sales scoping through implementation and expansion.

In this role, you will scope, sell, and deliver projects across a range of complexity, including internal BI and embedded analytics initiatives. You will own delivery outcomes, advocate for customers, and identify challenges and product gaps, partnering with internal teams to address them. Your insights will help shape product direction, strengthen the customer experience, and create opportunities for continued growth.

Responsibilities

Serve as the deep technical expert to solve complex data problems while defining best practices and design patterns for the Omni platform.
Provide insight and guidance on how to leverage Omni’s AI features to maximise impact of the platform.
Manage a portfolio of primarily Enterprise customers, overseeing scoping, resource allocation, and delivery approach.
Act as the primary customer-facing technical contact, building strong, long-term relationships.
Drive project results by managing consulting and delivery partners, ensuring alignment across all workstreams.
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate frontline customer feedback into actionable product direction.

About You

7+ years in technical consulting / project management, ideally in the data space
Deep hands-on expertise in data engineering and BI tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Mode), with a specific mastery of semantic layers like Omni or Looker.
Ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical audiences while thriving in fast-paced, collaborative, and evolving environments.
Experience across the full project lifecycle from positioning and scoping through to execution, ideally as a consultant.

A typical day for you at Omni:

30% Pre-sales technical support & scoping
40% Hands-on customer delivery
30% Internal best practices and ecosystem support

Location:

This is a hybrid role for candidates based in Dublin (3 days per week in-office). Candidates based in the UK will work remotely.

Why Join Us

Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) Plan (for US-based roles)
Unlimited PTO

Omni is an equal opportunity employer.
We value diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every single box. Please, let us know if you need any reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

Compensation Range: €150K - €170K

Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.

Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.

HRM Search Partners has partnered with a a leading international manufacturing organisation headquartered in Dublin, with operations spanning Europe and North America.
We are seeking a Senior Microsoft Dynamics AX Developer to join their global ERP and technology engineering team. In this role, you will lead complex AX developments, customisations, system enhancements, and integrations across core manufacturing, supply chain, and operational modules. Working within a multi-site environment, you will translate business requirements into clean, scalable X++ code and maintain the technical integrity of enterprise solutions.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Development & Customisation: Design, develop, and deploy robust customisations, modifications, and extensions within Microsoft Dynamics AX using X++, MorphX, and Application Object Tree (AOT).
Technical Integration: Build and maintain high-performance integrations between Dynamics AX, manufacturing execution systems (MES), enterprise reporting tools, third-party logistics platforms, and cloud services (AIF, DIXF, Web Services/APIs).
System Optimisation: Perform detailed code reviews, root-cause defect analysis, performance tuning, and database optimisation across high-volume SQL Server environments.
Requirements Mapping: Collaborate with solution architects, functional consultants, business analysts, and global operational leads to translate manufacturing workflow needs into technical design specifications.

L3 Technical Support: Provide high-tier technical troubleshooting, debugging, and escalation management for critical production platform customisations across EU and US manufacturing sites.

AX Experience: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics AX development, modification, and architecture customisations (Dynamics AX 2009, 2012 R2/R3).
Technical Mastery: Deep mastery of X++, MorphX environment, AOT, Security Framework, Application Integration Framework (AIF), Data Import Export Framework (DIXF), and SSRS reporting.
Language & Communication: C1/C2 Professional English Proficiency (IELTS 8+ equivalent) with excellent written and verbal communication skills for collaborating across international operational teams.
