Job Description

At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with product offerings that help them in their life, reinventing the world for good. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.

About Us

Tieto Caretech is modernizing the Nordic health and social care sector with modular, open, and interoperable software. We develop and deliver high quality software solutions and services that enable healthcare and welfare professionals to do their work even better and with higher efficiency - have more time to care.

We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can build technology for the good of society and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people in need.

About The Role

We are now looking for a Release Train Architect (RTA)
to work with Tieto Caretech
healthcare products where you will contribute to simplifying everyday life for patients, professionals and customers. In the architect role you will be ensuring that the architectural and technical decisions taken are aligned with Lifecare strategy, data security and set of requirements.

In this role you will

Design, implement, and verify software architecture with a focus on the bigger picture and product architecture.
Utilize advanced .NET concepts, design patterns, and SOLID design principles to develop robust software solutions.
Lead and mentor teams in web development using WebApi, Angular, HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, SPA, and NgRx/Redux.
Apply hands-on experience in the .Net Stack and other frameworks to deliver full-stack solutions.
Implement SOA, IOC, REST API, Microservices, and Event-driven architecture.

We are looking for someone with

10+ years of experience in the software industry.
Proficiency in both English and Finnish languages.
Extensive knowledge of web technologies and patterns.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Finland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Senior Software Tester
jobs.description:
Ben je gebeten door softwareontwikkeling? En hou je ervan om deel uit te maken van een agile team? Dan ben jij de senior software tester
die we zoeken! Je komt terecht in een enthousiast Scrum team. Samen ontwikkelen jullie business kritische applicaties en websites
om de groei en vooruitgang van VAB te ondersteunen.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel en technisch testen
van software, websites of applicaties. Dit kan gaan om integratietesten, regressietesten, testautomatisatie,…
Je documenteert
de testen in ons tracking systeem en zorgt voor de verdere opvolging.
Je bent volledig mee met het shift left principe
en levert al waardevolle input in de vroege fases van ontwikkeling, nog vóór de testuitvoering start. Hierdoor draag je bij aan een efficiënter en kwalitatief sterker eindproduct.
Samen met onze test coördinator
vorm je een dynamisch duo. Je fungeert als sparringpartner
en bent haar back-up
bij afwezigheid. Je bent in staat risico’s en impact in te schatten en geeft advies waar nodig. Je kan het team motiveren en efficiënt laten samenwerken. Je springt bij waar nodig!
Je behoudt een helikopterview, denkt vooruit en handelt proactief.
Je blijft kalm en efficiënt onder druk. Je werkt zelfstandig en neemt de nodige verantwoordelijkheid
op.

Wat breng je mee?

Je beschikt over een goede algemene kennis van software testing
en hebt een passie voor IT-systemen. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe verschillende componenten met elkaar integreren en legt vlot verbanden. Je denkt out-of-the-box en zoekt proactief naar oplossingen om snel resultaat te behalen. Bovendien speel je een actieve rol in refinement-sessies, waarbij je de QA-aanpak
al vroeg in het ontwikkelingsproces helpt optimaliseren.

Je bent in het bezit van een Bachelor of Master
diploma, een technische IT-achtergrond is een pluspunt.
Je hebt 3 tot 5 jaar relevante ervaring
opgebouwd in software testing, met een stevige basis in functionele en geautomatiseerde testen
. Hierdoor kan je moeiteloos optreden als sidekick van onze test coördinator.
Dankzij je technische achtergrond en aantoonbare ervaring met testautomatisatie speel je een sleutelrol in het optimaliseren van onze testprocessen.

Je hebt ervaring met het opstellen en uitvoeren van testscenario's en testplannen. Documenteren van testresultaten en opvolgen van defects in Azure Devops.

Je kan risico's en de impact van bugs inschatten en advies geven rond de prioritisering
.
Ervaring met tools zoals Selenium, Postman en SoapUI.

Je werkt graag in een team
, denkt proactief mee, stelt kritische vragen om processen te verbeteren en draagt oplossingsgericht
bij aan het versterken van kwaliteitsnormen.
Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden
breng je helderheid, enthousiasme en verbinding, terwijl je het overzicht bewaart.

Zijn volgende punten ook op jou van toepassing? Dan heb je een streepje voor!
ISTQB Foundation certificaat
Je hebt ervaring met Confluence en Azure DevOps.
Je hebt reeds eerder in een Microsoft Dynamics omgeving gewerkt (Power Platform en/of Finance & Operations)
Ervaring binnen SAFe of een ander op Agile gebaseerd framework.

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

Een warme welkom in ons team bij VAB, groot genoeg om van betekenis te zijn, klein genoeg om elkaar en onze business persoonlijk te kennen.
Een uitdagende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving, waar flexibiliteit en teamwerk centraal staan
Een open en informele bedrijfscultuur met korte communicatielijnen
Een marktconform en competitief loon, omdat jij dit verdient.
Een elektrische firmawagen, met laadpaal en marktconforme energievergoeding van thuisladen zodat ook jij kan bijdragen aan duurzame mobiliteit. Mogelijkheid tot laden in binnen- en buitenland
Een high end smartphone en gsm-abonnement om je mobiliteit te garanderen
Maaltijdcheques
Aansluiting bij KBC-pensioenfonds
Personeelsvoordelen op de producten van VAB en KBC
Een fietsleaseplan (vanaf 6 maanden dienst) én extra kilometervergoeding voor wie graag met de fiets komt
Mogelijkheid om 3 dagen van thuis uit te werken. We richten je thuiswerkplek in met professionele materialen (bureaustoel, laptop, headset, ...) en voorzien een netto onkostenvergoeding per thuiswerkdag
Glijdende werkuren
De toffe collega’s krijg je er bovenop!

Goed om weten

Ons kantoor is gelegen in Zwijndrecht vlak naast de E17. Het is ook vlot bereikbaar via het openbaar vervoer. Het treinstation is gelegen op 500m van kantoor, een tramhalte (tram 3) op 1.5 km. Kom je liever met de fiets? Ook dat is geen probleem. Er is een overdekte fietsenstalling en ook douches zijn voorzien.
VAB, daar kom je verder mee.

vinden we dat expertise en inzet correct beloond moeten worden. Daarom bieden we een sterk en competitief verloningspakket
dat bewust boven het klassieke marktconforme niveau kan liggen, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring, technische kennis en verantwoordelijkheden.

, afgestemd op jouw ervaring, competenties en toegevoegde waarde.

.
· Een 13e maand.

jobs.title: Senior Requirements Engineer Digital Product, 80-100%
jobs.description:
PEAX bietet eine Lösung für automatisierten Dokumenteneingang, intelligentes Document Processing und Weiterverarbeitung in nachgelagerten Geschäftsprozessen. Damit werden unsere Kunden von administrativem Aufwand befreit und erkennen den Wert ihrer Daten. Wir suchen Menschen, die unsere Produktentwicklung mit analytischer Tiefe und einem ausgeprägten AI-First-Mindset auf das nächste Level bringen.

Aufgaben
Das bewegst du

Du verantwortest das fachliche Herz unseres Produkts: das Domänenmodell. Capabilities, Business Objects, Business Rules und Prozesse hältst du korrekt, widerspruchsfrei und aktuell. Und du sorgst dafür, dass sie über Domänen hinweg zusammenpassen.

Aus vielschichtigen, oft widersprüchlichen Anforderungen machst du klare Struktur: Nachvollziehbare Use Cases, scharf geschnittene Anforderungen und eindeutige Akzeptanzkriterien. Dein wichtigster Beitrag ist dabei nicht, jeden Einzelwunsch zu spezifizieren. Es ist zu erkennen, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und die allgemeine Lösung durchzusetzen.

Du präzisierst Produktentscheide für die Umsetzung: Regeln, Grenzfälle, Zustände und Sollverhalten. Bei komplexen und domänenübergreifenden Themen führst du die Spezifikation selbst. Im Übrigen setzt du den Standard, nach dem im Team spezifiziert wird, und entwickelst die Modellierungskompetenz deiner Kolleg:innen weiter.

Qualität ist für dich Teil der Spezifikationsarbeit und kein nachgelagerter Schritt. Du erstellst E2E-Testkonzepte und Testfälle für deinen Bereich und prüfst Features. Wir sind ein kleines Team, in dem alle die Qualität des Produkts mittragen.

Du bist für die von dir verantworteten Features die fachliche Ansprechperson für Engineering, Design, Customer Success und Sales sowie für Partner, Reseller und Kunden. Du bist auch die Person, die „so geht das fachlich nicht“ sagen kann und dafür gehört wird.

Deine Arbeit startet in der Product Discovery: Bei der Problemrahmung, nicht erst bei der Übersetzung fertiger Entscheide. Zudem bringst du deine fachliche Sicht in Architekturentscheide ein, wo sie Konsequenzen für das Domänenmodell haben.

PEAX baut gerade agentische Architekturen. Du nutzt AI-Tools strukturiert und verantwortungsvoll als Bestandteil unseres Requirement Engineering Prozesses.

Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Senior-Erfahrung als Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im B2B-SaaS-Produktumfeld, idealerweise in einer Scale-up-Phase und mit Hintergrund in Document Management, ECM, Workflow-Automatisierung oder einem verwandten Information-Hub-Umfeld. Du hast dabei nachweisbar Verantwortung für fachliche Modelle getragen und nicht nur für Spezifikationsdokumente.

Ausbildungshintergrund in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Business Engineering, BWL mit IT-Affinität (FH, Universität). MSc-Niveau ideal, Bachelor mit entsprechender Senior-Erfahrung ebenfalls möglich.

Echte Modellierungstiefe: Du kannst ein Geschäftsproblem in Entitäten, Zustände, Regeln und Prozesse zerlegen, so dass das Ergebnis widerspruchsfrei ist. Du formulierst Akzeptanzkriterien so, dass sie prüfbar sind. Sicherer Umgang mit BPMN, UML, Use Cases und User Stories sowie mit Jira und Confluence. Kenntnisse in ArchiMate sind ein Pluspunkt.

Generalisierungsinstinkt: Du erkennst, wann mehrere Einzelfälle dasselbe allgemeine Problem sind, und setzt die allgemeine Lösung durch. Du fragst nach dem Problem, bevor du nach der Lösung fragst, und du kannst eine Anforderung auch ablehnen.

Eingehendes Verständnis für administrative Prozesse in KMU, die Aufbereitung von Daten und zur Verfügungstellung via Schnittstellen an Drittanwendungen. Damit zusammenhängend die Fähigkeit, Problemstellen in bestehenden Prozessen zu analysieren und durch intelligente Abläufe zu ersetzen.

Hohe Affinität zu AI-Tools, idealerweise erste Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter Spezifikationsarbeit, Prompt Engineering oder agentischen Systemen aus Produkt-Sicht.

Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau, Englisch verhandlungssicher (C1). Sicheres Auftreten auf C-Level.

jobs.title: Fleet & Device Engineer
jobs.description:
IN SHORT

Are you ready to own the edge runtime for thousands of smart fridges and coffee machines across Switzerland and the US? As our new Fleet & Device Engineer
(100%) in Zurich, you will join a close-knit 8-person engineering team to rebuild and manage the systems that power our hardware. In this hybrid role, you will take full ownership of our edge domain from day one, ensuring that our unglamorous but highly reliable hardware works seamlessly for real people getting their lunch every day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Take full, end-to-end ownership of the edge runtime on our smart fridges and Gavetti coffee machine controllers, managing everything from zero-touch provisioning, device bootstrap, call-home and on-device applications.
Drive the consolidation of our fleet management onto a single, reliable platform (such as Azure IoT Hub or KubeEdge), taking charge of making and defending the architectural choices.
Streamline the technology stack by reducing the number of languages running on the edge, bringing the device world closer to our cloud environment.
Collaborate closely with and report directly to the Head of Engineering to specify the next generation of hardware, select vendors, and define software contracts.
Inherit and manage crucial vendor relationships and integrations, including those for our vendors and various badge reader suppliers.
Ensure the team maintains a grounded, honest understanding of what is actually running and performing in the field.

YOUR PROFILE

Solid background with roughly 5+ years of experience building and operating production systems, specifically managing a real fleet of devices with live users, outages, and OTA updates.
Proficiency in at least two of the following languages: C#, Go, or Kotlin, coupled with a willingness to consolidate and standardize our tech stack.
Working knowledge of edge platform networking (VPNs, NAT, flaky links, office networks), running Linux and Android on small hardware, OS-level debugging, and observability for offline-tolerant systems.
Strong ability to treat hardware as an interface, including practical experience with Modbus, USB, serial connections, reading sensor datasheets, and working with vendor SDKs.
Familiarity with tools like Balena, Azure IoT Hub, KubeEdge, Kubernetes, Docker, or experience in commercial appliance ecosystems is a strong plus.
Pragmatic problem-solving mindset with a track record of putting the problem before the programming language, preferring standard, reliable tools over inventing custom solutions.
Fluency in English, German is nice to have
Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

OUR BENEFITS

Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation
Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing
Stay active and healthy with our weekly sports sessions

Does this sound like the job for you? We can't wait to learn more about you! APPLY NOW with your complete documents in either German or English.

ABOUT US

FELFEL is all about good food and coffee in the workplace: we help Swiss employers become masters of hospitality.
With our smart fridge ‘FELFEL’ and delicious barista coffee ‘Gavetti’, we enable companies to provide their employees with first-class, ultra-fresh food and drinks throughout the day. Whether hearty and traditional, modern and vegan or high in protein - our weekly changing menu ensures that all employees always have something to be excited about ;).

FELFEL is a family business that was founded in 2013. Today, we take care of around 1000 locations in Switzerland, and have 150 employees across our offices in Lausanne, Zurich and New York.

jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Austria.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Spain.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.

Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.

jobs.title: (Senior) DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
What We Need

Oivan is a digital engineering, AI, cloud, and cybersecurity services company. We help governments, giga-projects, and large enterprises build, modernize, operate, and secure mission-critical digital services. Our mission is to build intelligent digital platforms that matter — then help our clients run and improve them at scale.

We combine Nordic engineering standards with deep regional commitment, with our operational headquarters in Riyadh and delivery teams across the Middle East, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. Our clients come to us when they need to turn complex transformation goals into reliable, secure production systems.

Why This Role Matters

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you will design and operate the platforms that let our clients build, ship, and run software safely at enterprise scale. You will work across CI/CD, cloud, container orchestration, and security — bridging the gap between development, operations, and security teams so that releases are fast, repeatable, and secure.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role based in Riyadh. You will work on complex, mission-critical environments, lead discovery and migration activities, and help raise the bar on how Oivan delivers engineering platforms.

What You'll Do

Build and run CI/CD: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, following DevOps and DevSecOps best practices.
Architect cloud and hybrid environments: Design, implement, and manage cloud and hybrid environments across GCP, Oracle Cloud, or Azure.
Automate with IaC: Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployments using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and Ansible).
Operate container platforms: Design and operate container platforms using Kubernetes, SUSE Rancher, and OpenStack.
Run resilient data services: Deploy, manage, and maintain PostgreSQL clusters and Redis clusters (Sentinel-based) for high availability and resilience.
Manage service discovery: Implement and operate Consul clusters for service discovery and configuration management.
Design for resilience: Design and test Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions, including data replication, failover strategies, and DR networking setup.
Lead discovery and migration: Lead discovery and assessment of existing SDLC, CI/CD, and infrastructure environments, and plan and execute migrations from existing GitLab instances or other DevOps platforms (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Bitbucket) to new GitLab environments.
Stand up GitLab: Install, configure, and operate GitLab on-premise environments, and design GitLab reference architectures.
Document operations: Create and maintain Runbooks and Playbooks for product- and project-based operations.
Embed security: Implement security scanning and automated security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Bridge teams: Connect Development, Operations, and Security teams to deliver secure, reliable platforms.
Keep platforms healthy: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize platform performance, availability, and reliability.
Share knowledge: Conduct training sessions and knowledge transfer for customers and internal teams.
Engage clients: Work closely with customer stakeholders in on-site engagements in KSA.

What You Have

Core Experience

5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, CI/CD, or Platform Engineering.
Strong experience working in on-premise enterprise environments.
Ability to work independently in a customer-facing role.
Cloud
Experience with cloud administration on at least one of the following:
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
Microsoft Azure
Infrastructure as Code

Strong hands-on experience with:

Terraform
Ansible
CI/CD & GitLab
Hands-on experience with GitLab migrations and high-availability GitLab implementations.
Container & Orchestration
Expertise in container orchestration and platforms:
Kubernetes
SUSE Rancher
OpenStack
Data & Platform Services
Experience managing PostgreSQL clusters.
Experience with Redis clusters, including Sentinel.
Hands-on experience with object storage solutions.
Experience with Consul clusters for service discovery and configuration.
Resilience
Strong Disaster Recovery (DR) skills, including:
Data replication strategies
DR networking setup and failover planning

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

What We Offer

At Oivan, you'll join a diverse team of experts committed to delivering digital services that operate reliably for real users. We combine the speed and ambition of a scale-up with the stability required for mission-critical government and enterprise work.

Your growth and wellbeing are priorities. We offer continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a collaborative culture where we win together.

How We Work

Production impact: We build solutions that work in real operating environments — useful, measurable, secure, and maintainable.

Nordic engineering standards: We prioritize engineering excellence, security, and long-term maintainability.

One team: We match tasks to the right owner, stay agile as priorities shift, and collaborate to win.

Transparency: We go deep, ask questions, and understand the "why" behind every decision.

Initial Screening (TA + Hiring Manager)

Als Software Architect speel je een belangrijke rol bij het vertalen van strategische architectuurprincipes naar concrete technische oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met Enterprise Architects, developers en verschillende stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe en bestaande oplossingen aansluiten bij de technische en organisatorische doelstellingen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Software Architect ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen en verder ontwikkelen van toekomstbestendige softwareoplossingen. Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Vertalen van de doelarchitectuur naar concrete oplossingen die door developmentteams gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
Ontwerpen van oplossingsrichtingen in samenwerking met Enterprise Architects en ontwikkelteams.
Ontwerpen van softwarearchitecturen voor nieuwe producten en digitale diensten.
Opstellen van transitieplannen voor het moderniseren van bestaande oplossingen en applicaties.

Onderzoeken van nieuwe technologieën en beoordelen hoe deze binnen de organisatie kunnen worden toegepast.
Meewerken aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern softwarelandschap, bestaande uit zowel on-premise technologie als cloud- en SaaS-oplossingen.
Werken met Microsoft-technologie en Azure binnen een breed en voortdurend veranderend IT-landschap.
Fungeren als technisch sparringpartner voor developers en andere IT-professionals.
Coachen van ontwikkelaars en bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van softwarearchitectuur binnen de organisatie.

Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en professionele ontwikkeling.
Een laptop en smartphone of een passende telefoonvergoeding.

Join Protein Works as our Senior Backend Developer, and build a greenfield, cloud-native platform from the ground up using Go and modern microservices architecture.

About The Role

The Protein Works is a UK direct-to-consumer sports nutrition brand. We develop and manufacture our own products, sell them through our own e-commerce platform and ship them from our own warehouse. Behind the website sits a set of internal applications connecting orders, stock, finance, fulfilment and manufacturing, alongside a growing number of marketplaces and third-party services.

We are replacing those legacy internal applications with a new cloud-native platform: independently deployable services that will become the single integration layer between the website, finance, warehouse and manufacturing, and a foundation for AI-assisted automation across the business. This role is a core builder of that platform.

You will join a small, polyglot engineering team working DevOps, Information Security, Data and IT. Go is our preferred language for services because of its performance and operational simplicity, but we hire for engineering depth first: if your background is C#, Java or PHP and you are willing to work in Go, we want to hear from you.

What you will do

Platform Development & Architecture: Design, build, and maintain microservices and domain models (orders, stock, fulfilment, finance) using Go, Domain-Driven Design, enterprise integration patterns, and clean architecture to incrementally replace legacy applications.

Integration & Asynchronous Workflows: Build event-driven and queue-based workflows with REST APIs, authentication, idempotency, and contract testing to connect e-commerce, ERP, WMS, finance, and manufacturing systems.

Operations, Security & AI: Own end-to-end delivery including containers, CI/CD, IaC, full observability (metrics, traces, logs), security/privacy compliance (OWASP, GDPR, pen testing), and day-to-day use of AI-assisted/agentic tools.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across tech and business teams, write ADRs, contribute to golden-path templates/standards, and translate business needs into technical execution.

What you will bring

Essential

Backend & Architecture: 5+ years of backend development (Go, Java, C#, or PHP with a focus/openness to Go) with strong CS/software engineering foundations, SOLID principles, and clean/event-driven patterns across microservices and monoliths.
Data & Async Systems: Solid background in relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and asynchronous messaging (queues, events, retries, idempotency).
DevOps & Observability: Practical experience with Docker, Linux/Windows, Git/GitHub, Jira/Agile, monitoring/alerting, and diagnostic/profiling tools in high-volume e-commerce environments.
Communication & AI Integration: Strong problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills, coupled with active practice using AI development/coding tools.

Desirable

AI & Cloud Technologies: Agentic AI (LLMs, frameworks, guardrails) and cloud platforms (AWS, IaC/Terraform, serverless, managed messaging, Kubernetes, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch).
Advanced Engineering & Integrations: Production Go experience, GoF/Enterprise integration patterns, durable workflows, contract testing, ERP/WMS/e-commerce integrations, OpenTelemetry/Grafana/Datadog, and OWASP/ISO 27001 security standards.

How we work

Two-week sprints for planned platform work and a Kanban lane for operational and integration requests, both in Jira. Pull requests with code review, automated tests and CI/CD to staging and production. Architecture Decision Records for anything that changes the shape of the platform, and golden-path templates per language so services stay consistent without forcing one runtime. Observability, security and documentation are part of the definition of done.

Hybrid working
A greenfield platform to build, a modern toolchain and direct access to the decisions that shape both

A strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design principles, including Key Vault, managed identities, role-based access control (RBAC), and least privilege, is essential. Additionally, candidates should have hands-on experience with monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery strategies, including incident response and resolution. Familiarity with SQL Server management, Agile SCRUM methodologies, and environment data management is also necessary.

Desirable qualifications include Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert). Experience working with Azure PaaS services like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Data Factory, Synapse, or Microsoft Fabric is advantageous. Knowledge of C#/.NET for reading application code and debugging, as well as experience consolidating single-tenant deployments into multi-tenant platforms, is preferred. Candidates with experience in enterprise security requirements, such as ISO 27001 controls and penetration test remediation, will stand out. Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work is also desirable.

Responsibilities

Environment management. Provision, configure, and maintain the Astral environment estate—including development, testing, UAT/load, and production environments. Ensure environments are consistent, reproducible, and well-documented through infrastructure as code. Manage environment refreshes and test data in compliance with data protection policies.
CI/CD pipelines. Build, maintain, and continuously improve Azure DevOps build, test, and release pipelines. This includes artifact management, controlled build configurations, pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Work towards consolidating multiple per-client pipelines into a unified deployment process as the platform evolves into a multi-tenant architecture.
Release management. Plan and execute deployments through various environment stages to production, with rehearsed rollback procedures for each release. Support product go-lives and maintain a clear, communicated release calendar to ensure smooth transitions.
Security and access. Manage secrets and certificates using Azure Key Vault and managed identities. Implement role-based access control (RBAC) with a focus on least privilege, oversee platform patching, and collaborate with IT security teams on audit remediation and security release planning.
Monitoring, reliability, and recovery. Own observability tools such as Application Insights and Log Analytics. Set up alerting, backups, and disaster recovery plans, including periodic disaster recovery tests. Lead incident response efforts for platform issues and conduct blameless root-cause analyses to prevent recurrence.
Cost management. Monitor and optimize Azure spending across environments and clients. Right-size resources and report on key cost drivers to ensure efficient use of resources and budget adherence.
Documentation and knowledge sharing. Keep runbooks, environment documentation, and configuration records current by documenting work promptly. Aim to eliminate single points of failure through thorough documentation and knowledge transfer.

Your work will ensure seamless data exchange between customer-facing applications and core operational systems such as warehouse management, ERP, and finance platforms. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on high-performance, scalable, and resilient systems that support millions of data points daily. As part of our team, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including product managers, engineers, and operational teams, to deliver robust technical solutions that drive business success.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of four years of professional experience in backend software development, with a strong background in strongly typed programming languages. You should have proven expertise in integrating complex business-critical systems, particularly ERP, warehouse management, or finance platforms. Strong SQL skills, including database design and performance tuning, are essential. A solid understanding of software architecture principles such as SOLID, Clean Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design is required. Experience with modern development practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and version control systems like Git, is also necessary. Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications, message queues, and event-driven architectures will be highly advantageous. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders are critical for success in this role.

Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include designing, developing, and maintaining backend integrations between digital platforms and core business systems such as warehouse, ERP, and finance solutions. We are committed to providing a positive and stimulating workplace where your contributions make a meaningful impact.

Equal Opportunity

We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Współpraca z zespołami biznesowymi, deweloperami, architektami, Cybersecurity, Cloud, Data, AI Governance oraz zespołami lokalnymi na rynkach KRUK Group.
Wspieranie zespołów produktowych i procesowych podczas podłączania ich rozwiązań do KAIN.
Monitorowanie działania rozwiązań na środowiskach produkcyjnych oraz diagnozowanie i usuwanie problemów.
Eksperymentowanie z nowymi modelami, frameworkami agentowymi i podejściami do budowy rozwiązań AI, a następnie ocena ich przydatności biznesowej.

Doświadczenie w tworzeniu i wdrażaniu aplikacji lub usług backendowych.
Bardzo dobra znajomość co najmniej jednego języka programowania wykorzystywanego do budowy rozwiązań i integracji, preferowany Python
, mile widziany również C#/.NET
lub TypeScript
.
Praktyczne doświadczenie w pracy z API, usługami REST, formatami JSON oraz integracją systemów.
Znajomość usług chmurowych Microsoft Azure i podstaw architektury rozwiązań cloud-native.
Doświadczenie w pracy z generatywną AI lub LLM, obejmujące integrację modeli, prompt engineering i budowę aplikacji wykorzystujących modele językowe.
Znajomość podstawowych wzorców budowy rozwiązań RAG, wyszukiwania semantycznego i pracy z bazami wiedzy.
Umiejętność projektowania rozwiązań z uwzględnieniem bezpieczeństwa, kontroli dostępu, logowania i monitorowania.
Znajomość Git oraz dobrych praktyk związanych z code review, testowaniem i CI/CD.
Umiejętność diagnozowania problemów w rozwiązaniach rozproszonych i integracjach między systemami.
Umiejętność pracy z wymaganiami biznesowymi i przekładania ich na zadania techniczne, architekturę oraz działające rozwiązanie.
Samodzielność, odpowiedzialność za dostarczane komponenty i gotowość do pracy w interdyscyplinarnym, międzynarodowym środowisku.
Komunikatywna znajomość języka angielskiego pozwalająca na współpracę z zespołami na różnych rynkach KRUK Group.

Znajomość frameworków do budowy agentów i aplikacji LLM, takich jak LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen lub podobnych.
Praktyczne doświadczenie z Azure AI Document Intelligence, OCR, klasyfikacją dokumentów lub ekstrakcją danych.
Znajomość Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, Managed Identity, Service Principal oraz mechanizmów Role-Based Access Control.
Doświadczenie z Application Insights, OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor lub innymi narzędziami zapewniającymi observability.
Znajomość Infrastructure as Code, na przykład Terraform.
Doświadczenie w konteneryzacji i wdrażaniu rozwiązań z wykorzystaniem Docker oraz usług Kubernetes lub Azure Container Apps.

Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and effective documentation skills.

Experience with modelling in Archimate
Experience with European Interoperability Framework or other interinstitutional frameworks
Experience with applying architecture styles and patterns

new_jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Poland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. new_jobs.title: AI-Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Are you passionate about how AI can shape the insurance market?

Join either Data Discovery & Experience
or API Platform
, two teams within API & Data Products Solutions.

Our mission is to make APIs, MCPs and Data easy to discover, understand, and use. To support that journey, we are looking for an AI Developer who is excited about building the next generation of AI-powered experiences.

About The Role

You will help shape AI-powered experiences by enabling AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products to create value for developers, employees, partners, and customers.

Working hands-on with modern AI technologies, agent frameworks, APIs, and platform capabilities, you will build scalable solutions that enable teams across If to discover, access, and use digital capabilities more effectively.

As part of a cross-functional team of Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will turn emerging AI opportunities into practical solutions with measurable business impact.

Help evolve our Data Discovery & Experience or API Platform capabilities.
Design and develop AI-powered platform capabilities using AI agents, APIs, MCPs, and Data Products.
Improve how APIs, MCPs, and Data Products are discovered, understood, and used across If.
Help ensure secure access using open standards.
Apply platform engineering and product thinking to solve real business problems.
Contribute to AI literacy and AI-enabled ways of working.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

Depending on your background, interests, and experience, you may join either the Data Discovery & Experience
team or the API Platform
team.

The Data Discovery & Experience
team works closely with business and technical stakeholders to improve how APIs and Data are discovered, understood, and used as Products across If.

The API Platform
team focuses on building and evolving common platform capabilities that enable secure, scalable, and efficient API consumption and integration across If and with external partners.

Both teams use agile ways of working and collaborate closely with stakeholders across business and technology domains.

This position is also a part of a larger agile Tribe responsible for providing common API and IAM capabilities that enable If's business to grow in a secure, scalable, and compliant manner. We support both internal teams and external partners through technology, products, processes, training, and governance.

Who are you?

You are curious, innovative, and motivated by making hard things look easy.

You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and turning ideas into working solutions. You combine strong technical skills with a product mindset and are excited about creating experiences that are useful, intuitive, and valuable to users.

You are comfortable navigating uncertainty, learning quickly, and working in a field that is evolving.

You see AI not as a standalone technology, but as a capability that becomes powerful when combined with data, business processes, and great user experiences.

You are passionate about agile ways of working, continuous improvement, and exploring new technologies.

You have the ability to make complex technical concepts understandable and actionable for both technical and business stakeholders.

You Also Have

Relevant university degree, preferably within Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data & Analytics, or a related technical field. Equivalent practical experience is also valued.
Experience in the insurance industry or another regulated industry, such as banking, finance, healthcare, telecommunications, or the public sector.
At least 3 years of experience in software engineering and modern application development.
At least 1-2 years of practical, hands-on experience applying AI engineering practices in production or real-world applications.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C#, TypeScript, or Python.

Experience from one or more of the following areas is considered a strong advantage:

AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, and Agent Frameworks such as LangGraph, Pydantic AI, Microsoft Agent Framework, or similar technologies.
MCP (Model Context Protocol), including providing AI systems with context, tools, and access to enterprise capabilities.
Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and model orchestration.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, and semantic search technologies.
APIs, API Platforms, integration technologies, and secure access using open standards, as well as Data Products, Data Discovery, Analytics Platforms, and Developer Experience capabilities.
Cloud-native application development using Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.

Additional facts and the recruitment process

Application deadline:
Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is October 11, 2026.

To apply for the position:
Please attach your CV and fill in the questionnaires

Work location:
Bergshamra, Stockholm

Travelling:
Some travel within the Nordics and Baltics is required

Start:
Upon agreement

For more information, please contact Daniel Sahlin, Head of API and Data Product Solutions, +46 (0) 771 43 00 00

Final candidates will undergo a background check before employment.

We look forward to your application!

new_jobs.title: Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer
new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Sweden.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

new_jobs.description:
About Omni

Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives enterprises a governed context graph for analytics and AI. Teams use Omni to ask questions in plain English, refine answers in workbooks, and bring trusted data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Omni has raised $217M from the world’s top investors, including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, First Round Capital, Redpoint Ventures, and GV. Its latest $120M Series C valued the company at $1.5B.

About The Role

We are seeking a Managing Architect to join our Professional Services team, helping customers get to value faster while driving successful outcomes across the customer lifecycle. You will lead complex technical engagements, serve as a trusted advisor to customers, and partner closely with Sales and delivery partners from pre-sales scoping through implementation and expansion.

In this role, you will scope, sell, and deliver projects across a range of complexity, including internal BI and embedded analytics initiatives. You will own delivery outcomes, advocate for customers, and identify challenges and product gaps, partnering with internal teams to address them. Your insights will help shape product direction, strengthen the customer experience, and create opportunities for continued growth.

Responsibilities

Serve as the deep technical expert to solve complex data problems while defining best practices and design patterns for the Omni platform.
Provide insight and guidance on how to leverage Omni’s AI features to maximise impact of the platform.
Manage a portfolio of primarily Enterprise customers, overseeing scoping, resource allocation, and delivery approach.
Act as the primary customer-facing technical contact, building strong, long-term relationships.
Drive project results by managing consulting and delivery partners, ensuring alignment across all workstreams.
Partner with Product and Engineering teams to translate frontline customer feedback into actionable product direction.

About You

7+ years in technical consulting / project management, ideally in the data space
Deep hands-on expertise in data engineering and BI tools (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Mode), with a specific mastery of semantic layers like Omni or Looker.
Ability to bridge the gap between technical and non-technical audiences while thriving in fast-paced, collaborative, and evolving environments.
Experience across the full project lifecycle from positioning and scoping through to execution, ideally as a consultant.

A typical day for you at Omni:

30% Pre-sales technical support & scoping
40% Hands-on customer delivery
30% Internal best practices and ecosystem support

Location:

This is a hybrid role for candidates based in Dublin (3 days per week in-office). Candidates based in the UK will work remotely.

Why Join Us

Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team
Health, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) Plan (for US-based roles)
Unlimited PTO

Omni is an equal opportunity employer.
We value diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every single box. Please, let us know if you need any reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

Compensation Range: €150K - €170K

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior IBM Datacap Administrator / Developer based in Ireland.

This is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced IBM Datacap professional to contribute to the development and evolution of an enterprise document-processing platform. The role spans Datacap development, platform administration, integrations, troubleshooting, testing, deployment, and production support. You will help transform business requirements into secure, scalable, and reliable technical solutions. Working within an Agile product engineering environment, you will collaborate across development, architecture, testing, and operations. The position offers the opportunity to build new capabilities while supporting critical enterprise workflows. Experience with modern integrations, DevSecOps practices, and secure enterprise environments will be highly valuable. This is an ideal role for someone who combines deep Datacap expertise with strong software development and problem-solving capabilities.

Accountabilities

Design, develop, configure, enhance, and maintain IBM Datacap applications, including rulesets, tasks, actions, document hierarchies, workflows, validation rules, and verification processes.
Configure and optimize OCR, document recognition, classification, data extraction, field validation, image processing, and batch-processing capabilities.
Develop reusable Datacap components and custom actions or extensions, including business rules for document routing, validation, exception handling, and processing.
Install, configure, administer, monitor, and maintain Datacap environments across Development, Test, QA, UAT, and Production.
Administer and troubleshoot Datacap Server, Rulerunner, Datacap Studio, and Datacap Navigator, including processing queues, logs, performance, failed batches, OCR issues, workflow failures, connectivity problems, and production incidents.
Participate throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, sprint planning, development, testing, deployment, release planning, and post-deployment stabilization.
Translate business requirements and user stories into technical solutions, estimate development effort, conduct peer reviews, troubleshoot defects, and implement sustainable fixes.
Develop and support integrations using REST APIs, SOAP web services, databases, file-based interfaces, enterprise content repositories, workflow platforms, and business applications.
Integrate document-processing capabilities with enterprise platforms such as IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator where applicable.
Manage metadata mapping, database lookups, document and metadata exports, API data exchange, retries, error handling, audit logging, and exception management.
Develop and maintain custom components using C#, .NET, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, REST, and SOAP, with particular emphasis on C#/.NET for custom Datacap actions and extensions.
Support secure enterprise and federal environments, including practices related to NIST, FISMA, IAM/RBAC, audit logging, vulnerability remediation, application security, PII protection, and configuration management.
Contribute to source control, CI/CD, automated deployments, release management, environment configuration, monitoring, incident management, and DevSecOps practices.

Requirements

5+ years of hands-on IBM Datacap experience, including strong experience with IBM Datacap 9.x/9.1.x.
Strong Datacap Studio development experience, along with hands-on Rulerunner administration and development.
Proven experience developing Datacap rulesets, workflows, tasks, actions, and other custom processing components.
Strong understanding of document capture and intelligent document processing, including OCR, classification, extraction, validation, verification, and image processing.
Enterprise-level Datacap administration experience across multiple environments, with strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Experience integrating Datacap with databases and enterprise systems, including strong SQL capabilities and REST and/or SOAP integration experience.
Working knowledge of Windows Server and IIS.
Experience participating in Agile application or product development environments, from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
Experience with IBM FileNet P8 and IBM Content Navigator is highly preferred.
C#/.NET experience and a background in developing custom Datacap actions or extensions are highly valued.
Experience with Java, JavaScript, SQL Server, Oracle, or DB2 is advantageous.
Familiarity with federal government IT environments, FISMA, NIST, DevSecOps, CI/CD, enterprise application integration, and secure handling of sensitive or PII data is preferred.
Experience building and enhancing new enterprise products, rather than exclusively maintaining legacy applications, is a strong advantage.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Contract engagement with an enterprise-focused technology environment.
Opportunity to work on a large-scale document-processing product with significant technical scope.
Exposure to IBM Datacap, enterprise integrations, intelligent document processing, and modern DevSecOps practices.
Opportunity to contribute across development, architecture, administration, integration, deployment, and production support.
Collaboration within an Agile product engineering environment.
Experience working with enterprise and secure federal technology environments.
Compensation and contract benefits aligned with the engagement and applicable market conditions.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
